media.alt: Runtime architecture of the Exabeam Agentic SOC plugin: the agent host calls a local bridge MCP that proxies to the Exabeam MCP, canonicalizing input and neutralizing output, with observra recording a metadata-only audit trail.
media.caption: Runtime architecture: the local bridge proxies to the Exabeam MCP, screens what the agent reads, neutralizes what it writes back, and records a metadata-only audit trail
